highlights: REPORTED DILUTED EPS $1.95; ADJUSTED DILUTED EPS $2.18, +5%
Strong execution drove broad-based acceleration, with reported sales growth of 13% and organic sales growth accelerating to 7%.
Ecolab's growth engines accelerated, driven by 63% organic sales growth in Global High-Tech and 17% organic sales growth in Life Sciences.
outlook: Ovivo Electronics and CoolIT also performed exceptionally well and, one year after close, are expected to contribute approximately 2 percentage points to Ecolab's annual organic sales growth.
2026: Expect adjusted diluted EPS in the $8.10 to $8.20 range, +8% to 9%.
4Q 2026: Expect adjusted diluted EPS in the $2.13 to $2.23 range, +2% to 7%.

items.heading: Our results are impacted by general worldwide economic factors.
Our results depend upon the continued vitality of the markets we serve.
Our significant non-U.S. operations expose us to global economic, political and legal risks that could impact our profitability.

Our increasing reliance on artificial intelligence (“AI”) technologies in our products, services, and operations presents several risks that could adversely impact our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
We are subject to information technology system failures, network disruptions and breaches in data security.
Our results could be materially and adversely affected by difficulties in securing the supply of certain raw materials or by fluctuations in the cost of raw materials.
